The recipe, step one

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands beside a pot and a recipe card with five lines. Four lines get checked off one by one, each with a happy pulse. The fifth line stays blank. At the end its eyes go wide and it trembles. The text changes from: me starting the recipe at step one, to: step 5: rest overnight. it is 6 pm.
